faculty.name: Gerry Altmann
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals build representations of events described by unfolding language using eye-tracking and neuroscientific methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体如何通过不断的语言描述构建事件表征，使用眼动追踪和神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Robert Astur
faculty.summary: Studies the memory of neurobiology, focusing on the hippocampus and amygdala, using tasks that are highly translational to examine risk factors for anxiety disorders, substance abuse, and depression.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经生物学中的记忆，重点是海马体和杏仁核，使用高度可转化的任务来研究焦虑障碍、物质滥用和抑郁症的风险因素，并开发干预措施。

faculty.name: Nick Audette
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain combines sensory input with environmental context to help perceive the world, using neural recordings in mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何结合感官输入和环境上下文来帮助感知世界，使用小鼠的大规模神经记录。

faculty.name: Augusto Buchweitz
faculty.summary: Studies early literacy and brain development in underrepresented populations, using brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究欠发达地区儿童的早期读写能力和大脑发展，采用脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Jeffrey Burke
faculty.summary: Studies the development and outcomes of disruptive behavior disorders, focusing on irritability and its link to depression and anxiety in children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究破坏性行为障碍的发展及其后果，重点关注易怒与儿童抑郁和焦虑之间的联系。

faculty.name: Leslie Burton
faculty.summary: Studies gender and cultural differences in cognition and emotion, including metacognition and frontal lobe functioning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别、文化和个体差异的认知和情绪，包括元认知和前额叶功能。

faculty.name: Chi-Ming Chen
faculty.summary: Studies the neural oscillations and their role in schizophrenia, using electrophysiology and transcranial magnetic stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经振荡及其在精神分裂症中的作用，使用电生理学和经颅磁刺激方法。

faculty.name: James Chrobak
faculty.summary: Studies how neuronal synchronization in the hippocampus varies along the septotemporal axis and how it is affected by environmental factors, behavior, and pharmacology, relating to memory formation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究海马沿隔底轴的神经同步性如何变化以及受环境因素、行为和药理学影响，并与记忆形成的关系。

faculty.name: Marie Coppola
faculty.summary: Studies language acquisition and creation, focusing on how early exposure to language affects numerical cognition in deaf and hearing children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言习得和创造，重点关注早期语言接触如何影响聋童和听童的数理认知。

faculty.name: Kimberly Cuevas
faculty.summary: Studies the development of cognitive skills in infants and young children, focusing on learning, memory, and executive function using EEG methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿认知技能的发展，重点在于学习、记忆和工作记忆，使用EEG方法。

faculty.name: James Dixon
faculty.summary: Studies self-organization in perception, action, and cognition, and thermodynamic origins of behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、动作和认知的自组织以及行为的热力学起源。

faculty.name: Amy Egbert
faculty.summary: Studies how social stressors, particularly discriminatory experiences, influence the development of psychopathology in youth, with a focus on eating disorders and coping mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会压力源（尤其是歧视性经历）如何影响青少年心理障碍的发展，特别是饮食障碍和应对机制。

faculty.name: Inge-Marie Eigsti
faculty.summary: Studies the neurocognitive processes underlying language acquisition and social communication in autism, using brain imaging and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症的语言获取和社会沟通的认知神经过程，使用脑成像和行为方法。

faculty.name: Roslyn Fitch
faculty.summary: Studies rodent models of developmental disability and neonatal brain injury, focusing on the modulating effects of hormones and experience, and neuroprotection.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发育性残疾和新生儿脑损伤的啮齿动物模型，关注激素和经验的作用以及神经保护。

faculty.name: Till Frank
faculty.summary: Studies human perception and motor control using dynamical systems and stochastic modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类感知和运动控制，使用动力系统和随机建模方法。

faculty.name: Alexandra Garr-Schultz
faculty.summary: Studies identity, self-definition, and experiences of marginalization among underrepresented groups, using experimental and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究边缘化群体的身份、自我定义及其经历，采用实验和定性方法。

faculty.name: Amy Gorin
faculty.summary: Studies weight loss and maintenance strategies, focusing on motivational and environmental factors affecting eating and physical activity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究减肥和维持策略，重点关注影响饮食和身体活动的动机和环境因素。

faculty.name: Sarah Gray
faculty.summary: Studies the developmental consequences of trauma and early life adversity, focusing on intergenerational processes and prevention programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期创伤和生活逆境的发展后果，重点关注代际过程和预防项目。

faculty.name: Fumiko Hoeft
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of brain development and learning, focusing on literacy skills and dyslexia in children.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和学习的神经生物学机制，重点关注儿童的阅读技能和诵读障碍。

faculty.name: Blair Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies health promotion, specifically exercise, mindfulness, and music performance anxiety, using meta-analysis and spatiotemporal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康促进，特别是运动、正念和音乐表演焦虑，使用元分析和时空方法。

faculty.name: Seth Kalichman
faculty.summary: Studies the behavioral and social aspects of HIV/AIDS, focusing on interventions to prevent HIV spread and improve health care access and adherence.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究艾滋病的行为和社会方面，重点在于预防艾滋病传播和提高医疗保健准入及依从性的干预措施。

faculty.name: Arielle Keller
faculty.summary: Studies attention as a core element of human cognition, using neuroimaging and behavioral methods to explore its development and disruptions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意力作为人类认知的核心要素，通过神经成像和行为评估方法探索其发展和中断。

faculty.name: Nicole Landi
faculty.summary: Studies reading and language development using ERP, MRI, and neuroimaging genetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用ERP、MRI和神经影像遗传学研究阅读和语言发展。

faculty.name: Edward Large
faculty.summary: Studies auditory neuroscience and music psychology, using psychophysics, fMRI, and EEG to understand neural dynamics in response to music.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉神经科学和音乐心理学，使用心理物理学、fMRI 和 EEG 理解音乐对神经动态的影响。

faculty.name: Vicki Magley
faculty.summary: Studies workplace incivility and sexual harassment, focusing on interventions and their effectiveness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究职场不礼貌和性骚扰，关注干预措施及其有效性。

faculty.name: James Magnuson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and behavioral bases of language processing, including spoken and written language, using computational models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言处理的神经和行为基础，包括口头和书面语言，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Etan Markus
faculty.summary: Studies how memory formation changes with aging, focusing on the hippocampal system in rats using behavioral tasks and neural monitoring.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆形成随年龄变化的机制，重点关注大鼠的海马系统，使用行为任务和神经监测技术。

faculty.name: Kerry Marsh
faculty.summary: Studies motivational and affective processes in persuasion, social cognition, and behavior, using immersive virtual reality methods and ecological approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机和情感过程在说服、社会认知和行为中的作用，使用沉浸式虚拟现实方法和生态学方法。

faculty.name: Steven Mellor
faculty.summary: Studies union-management psychology and self-evaluation in the workplace, focusing on union tolerance and work motivation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工会-管理层心理学和工作场所的自我评价，重点关注工会容忍度和工作动机。

faculty.name: Jonas Miller
faculty.summary: Studies how social and physical environmental factors affect brain development, empathy, and mental health in children and adolescents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和物理环境因素如何影响儿童和青少年的大脑发育、同理心和心理健康。

faculty.name: Crystal Park
faculty.summary: Studies coping with stress, meaning making, and yoga's effects on health, particularly in cancer survivors and veterans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究应对压力、意义构建以及瑜伽对健康的影响，特别是在癌症幸存者和退伍军人中的应用。

faculty.name: Alexandra Paxton
faculty.summary: Studies communication and social interaction as a complex dynamical system, using data-rich and dynamics-focused methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究沟通和社会互动作为复杂的动态系统，采用数据丰富和动态导向的方法。

faculty.name: Felicia Pratto
faculty.summary: Studies the processes and consequences of inequality, including race- and sex-discrimination, using experiments and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不平等的过程及其后果，包括种族和性别歧视，使用实验和调查方法。

faculty.name: Kenneth Pugh
faculty.summary: Studies reading processes and phonological deficits using fMRI and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读过程和音位缺陷，使用功能性磁共振成像和神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: Diane Quinn
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and health outcomes of people with socially stigmatized identities, focusing on obesity and weight stigma.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会上标签化身份个体的心理和健康结果，重点关注肥胖和体重标签化。

faculty.name: Nairán Ramírez-Esparza
faculty.summary: Studies how culture and language influence personality, behavior, and health using digital recording devices, text analysis, and brain measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化和语言如何影响人格、行为和健康，使用数字录音设备、文本分析和脑部测量方法。

faculty.name: John Salamone
faculty.summary: Studies the behavioral functions of neurotransmitters like dopamine, acetylcholine, serotonin, and adenosine, using animal models of neurological and psychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多巴胺、乙酰胆碱、血清素和腺苷等神经递质的行为功能，使用神经精神障碍的动物模型进行研究。

faculty.name: Rhiannon Smith
faculty.summary: Studies friendships and social-emotional adjustment in childhood and adolescence, focusing on the development of social cognition and empathy in friendships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和青少年时期的友谊和社会情绪适应，重点关注友谊中社会认知和同理心的发展。

faculty.name: Lorena Solis
faculty.summary: Studies diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring, retention, and career advancement practices for marginalized groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多样性和包容性在招聘、保留和职业晋升实践中的表现，特别是针对历史上被边缘化的群体。

faculty.name: Ian Stevenson
faculty.summary: Develops computational tools to model neural dynamics and link neural data with perception, behavior, and learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算工具来描述和解码神经活动，将神经数据与感知、行为和学习联系起来。

faculty.name: Umay Suanda
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and young children learn words from their environment, focusing on statistical learning and the dynamics of early social interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和幼儿如何从环境中学词，重点在于统计学习和社会互动的动力学。

faculty.name: Whitney Tabor
faculty.summary: Studies how structured systems and language change through sentence processing and group coordination, using cognitive and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究结构系统和语言变化的句法和语义编码，以及群体协调，采用认知和计算方法。

faculty.name: Kimberli Treadwell
faculty.summary: Studies childhood anxiety and worry, focusing on generalized anxiety disorder in adolescents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童焦虑和担忧，特别是在青少年中的广泛焦虑障碍。

faculty.name: Maxim Volgushev
faculty.summary: Studies the neurophysiology of the visual system, focusing on signal processing in visual cortical neurons and synaptic transmission.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉系统的神经生理学，重点在于视觉皮层神经元的信号处理和突触传递。

faculty.name: Eiling Yee
faculty.summary: Studies how meaning is represented in the brain, focusing on semantic memory and the neural basis of language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究概念的认知神经科学，特别是语义记忆和语言的神经基础。
